description: This file defines the class 'MicCaptureManager' which manages microphone input and speech recognition for an Android voice assistant app. It handles starting/stopping listening sessions, processing recognition results, managing conversation state, and interacting with a gateway for speech processing.

classes.name: VoiceConversationRole
classes.description: Enum representing the role in a voice conversation, either User or Assistant.

classes.name: VoiceConversationEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a single entry in the conversation, including id, role, text, and streaming status.

classes.name: MicCaptureManager
classes.description: Main class managing microphone input, speech recognition, conversation state, and interaction with a gateway for a voice assistant app.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables microphone listening. Starts or stops recognition accordingly.

methods.name: pauseForTts
methods.description: Pauses recognition to allow TTS speech to play.

methods.name: resumeAfterTts
methods.description: Resumes recognition after TTS speech playback.

methods.name: onGatewayConnectionChanged
methods.description: Updates the connection status with the gateway.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming events from the gateway related to speech recognition and conversation flow.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and begins speech recognition session if permissions are granted.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops speech recognition and cleans up resources.

methods.name: startListeningSession
methods.description: Configures and starts the speech recognizer listening session.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of the recognition session after a delay.

methods.name: queueRecognizedMessage
methods.description: Queues a recognized speech segment for processing.

methods.name: scheduleTranscriptFlush
methods.description: Schedules a flush to process partial transcripts after a timeout.

methods.name: publishQueue
methods.description: Publishes the current message queue to the observable state.

methods.name: sendQueuedIfIdle
methods.description: Sends the next message if the system is idle and connected.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for awaiting gateway response, retries if timeout occurs.

methods.name: completePendingTurn
methods.description: Completes current message processing and prepares for next.

methods.name: queuedWaitingStatus
methods.description: Returns a status string indicating message queue size and waiting state.

methods.name: appendConversation
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the conversation history.

methods.name: updateConversationEntry
methods.description: Updates a conversation entry by ID with new text and streaming status.

methods.name: upsertPendingAssistant
methods.description: Inserts or updates the assistant's message in the conversation history.

methods.name: playAssistantReplyAsync
methods.description: Uses TTS to speak the assistant's response asynchronously.

methods.name: disableMic
methods.description: Disables microphone and cleans up recognition resources.
